column1: # Zilocar analysis of NHTSA ODI consumer complaints: share of complaints on file within N days of the reported failure date
# source: COMPLAINTS_RECEIVED_2015-2019/2020-2024/2025-2026.zip, static.nhtsa.gov/odi/ffdd/cmpl/, retrieved 2026-10-11; newest filing inside 2026-10-08
# universe: 784,010 distinct vehicle complaints (ODINO-deduped, PROD_TYPE=V), 783,339 with a usable FAILDATE/LDATE pair
# cohort: failures 2017-2023 (n=420,008) - the band with neither left nor right truncation. Pooled curve capped at day 730, which every cohort supports.
# denominator is complaints ON FILE at 2026-10-08, not all complaints that will ever be filed. No registration denominator exists, so no figure here is a failure rate.
